results.title: Netcore names Tariq Ahmad as Chief Revenue Officer
results.description: The marketing technology company is targeting a doubling of overseas sales within three years as it steps up expansion beyond India.

results.title: China Masters: Lakshya Sen loses to Victor Lai in first round, Kidambi Srikanth beats Chi Yu Jen
results.description: Lakshya Sen suffered another early exiit after losing to Canada’s Victor Lai in the first round at the China Masters on Tuesday. Kidambi Srikanth defeated China’s Chi Yu Jen to enter the next round.
